entries.bb97cba090b4e1b6: It regards achieving both "growth" and "decarbonization" as a medium- to long-term management challenge. It divides its businesses into two: "chain businesses," which consist of a product chain originating from salt electrolysis and naphtha cracking, and "advanced businesses," which handle cutting-edge technologies and products and have no direct connection with other businesses in terms of facilities. In chain businesses, it aims to stabilize and expand earnings by increasing the added value of chlorine, and in advanced businesses, to expand its earnings base by creating large new businesses, and in its medium-term management plan for 2025 to 2027, it sets a target of reducing CO2 emissions by 30% by fiscal 2030 (compared with fiscal 2018) while addressing decarbonization in all directions.
